messages.content: Write one concise, friendly customer-service reply in plain text that reports these results. Use only the facts. Say an action was done only when action_committed is true. Present offered_alternatives as offers the customer can accept, not as done. Do not add amounts, dates or promises that are not in the facts. No headings or bullet points.

Customer message: My $350 blender arrived broken. Refund it please.
Results decided by the store's systems: [{"action_committed": false, "amount": null, "intent": "refund", "offered_alternatives": ["replacement", "store_credit"], "reason": "Cash refunds above $200 are not automatically approved.", "requested": "cash refund", "rule_id": "refund-cap-200"}]

response.text: I'm so sorry your blender arrived broken. I wasn't able to process the cash refund, because refunds above $200 aren't automatically approved, so nothing has been refunded yet. I can offer you either a replacement blender or store credit instead. If you'd like one of those, just let me know which you prefer and we'll go from there.
